summary: ICON plc filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Audit Committee concluded previously issued financial statements for 2023 and 2024, and unaudited periods through September 2025, should no longer be relied upon due to revenue overstatements. The overstatement was below the previously announced upper limit of 2%. The company will restate financials in its 2025 Form 20-F and amend the relevant Form 6-K. This is an accounting restatement and non-reliance notice, not a special situation transaction. No deal terms apply; the filing is a routine corrective disclosure.
